description: What technicians actually found when they diagnosed refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers or ovens/ranges, optionally for one brand (samsung, lg, whirlpool, ge, frigidaire, maytag, kenmore, hisense), as a share of diagnosed repair jobs from real repair records. Use it for "what usually goes wrong with my Samsung fridge?" or, with problem, "my Samsung fridge is not making ice, what is it usually?". It is not a reliability ranking. Findings marked pro_only involve gas, 240-volt power or sealed refrigerant and must not be suggested as DIY.

problem.description: Optional: what the customer says is wrong, e.g. "not making ice", "won't drain", "not heating". Returns what technicians found for THAT complaint.

name: what_breaks
title: What actually breaks on an appliance
